title: Prescribed Bayesian Efficiency under Lifetime Adjustment Costs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A Bayesian learner may retain an issued action while updating its posterior, trading predictive loss against adjustment charges. We assume population curvature, boundary control, an order-$1/n$ lower bound on expected posterior uncertainty about the optimal action, and an observable unbiased gradient witness whose squared norms are uniformly integrable. Sample losses may be unbounded or nonconvex. Cumulative expected excess measures the loss increase relative to current predictive Bayes actions. For bounded nonnegative nondecreasing charges $c$ with $c(0)=0$ and nondecreasing profiles $G: \mathbb{N} \to [1,\infty)$ with $G(J)=o(J)$, we characterize joint attainability of cumulative expected excess $O(G(J))$ at horizons $T=2^J$ and finite expected lifetime charge. translated_title: 终身调整成本约束下的规定贝叶斯效率
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯学习者可能在进行后验更新的同时保留已发出的动作，在预测损失与调整费用之间进行权衡。我们假设存在总体曲率、边界控制、关于最优动作的期望后验不确定性的 1/n 阶下界，以及一个可观测的无偏梯度见证，其平方范数一致可积。样本损失可以是无界的或非凸的。累积期望超额损失衡量相对于当前预测贝叶斯动作的损失增加。对于满足 c(0)=0 的有界非负非递减费用 c，以及满足 G(J)=o(J) 的非递减剖面 G: ℕ → [1,∞)，我们刻画了在时间范围 T=2^J 下累积期望超额损失 O(G(J)) 与有限期望终身费用的联合可达性。这里 J 是对数时间的索引。判据是跨动作距离尺度上带前缀约束的跟踪误差配额分配的有限性，等价地……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文刻画了在终身调整成本约束下，贝叶斯学习者在时间范围 T=2^J 处同时实现累积期望超额损失 O(G(J)) 与有限期望终身费用的可达性准则，即跨动作距离尺度上带前缀约束的跟踪误差配额分配的有限性。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes joint attainability of cumulative expected excess O(G(J)) at horizons T=2^J and finite expected lifetime charge for a Bayesian learner, with the criterion being finiteness of a prefix-constrained allocation of tracking-error allowances across action-distance scales.
